core: Amino acid and peptide transmembrane transport
qualifier: neutral and imino amino acids plus proton-coupled oligopeptides
name: Neutral amino acid and proton-coupled oligopeptide transport
rationale: Members are transporters and inherited defects (SLC6A19/SLC6A20/SLC36A2, Hartnup, iminoglycinuria) moving neutral/imino amino acids and di/oligopeptides; unlike the confusables it has proton/oligopeptide cotransport and lacks cystine, urate and organic anion transport.

qualifier: entry, uncoating and reverse transcription
name: HIV entry, uncoating and reverse transcription
rationale: All four members are the pre-integration early steps of HIV infection, distinguishing the theme from confusables covering Nef/Vpu host-protein downregulation, APOBEC3G restriction and viral DNA integration.

qualifier: respiratory burst and degranulation
name: Phagocyte respiratory burst, degranulation and antimicrobial killing
rationale: Members concern neutrophil/phagocyte oxidative burst, superoxide generation, degranulation and killing of bacteria and fungi, whereas confusables centre on chemotaxis, formyl peptide and complement receptor signalling.

qualifier: protein localization to centrosome and cell cortex
name: Centrosome positioning and cortical protein localization
rationale: All members concern establishing or maintaining centrosome position and targeting proteins to the centrosome and cortex, distinct from the confusables' spindle orientation, mitotic progression and meiotic programmes.

qualifier: adiponectin and fatty acid uptake/oxidation
name: Insulin- and adiponectin-regulated glucose and fatty acid uptake
rationale: Members cover GLUT4 translocation, insulin-stimulated glucose import, insulin receptor recycling/clearance, adiponectin signalling and fatty acid import/oxidation control, unlike confusables focused on beta-cell secretion, glucagon signalling or adipocyte lipolysis.

qualifier: p53/mTORC1 control and lactate fermentation
name: p53/mTORC1 regulation of glycolysis and lactate fermentation
rationale: Members combine control of glycolysis, pentose-phosphate shunt and nucleotide catabolism with p53 and mTORC1 programmes and lactate production, distinguishing them from HIF hypoxia, FOXO, TCA/NADPH and fructose-2,6-bisphosphate confusables.

qualifier: inherited RPIA and TALDO1 enzyme defects
name: Non-oxidative pentose phosphate pathway and inherited enzyme defects
rationale: All members are interconversions of the non-oxidative pentose phosphate branch or its RPIA/TALDO1 deficiencies, unlike confusables on glucuronate/xylulose, fructose, galactose and glycerol metabolism.

qualifier: gastrointestinal and urinary tract, stomach function
name: Gastrointestinal and urinary tract motility and stomach function
rationale: Members cover peristalsis, gastric and intestinal smooth muscle contraction, micturition, gastric acid secretion and stomach development, distinct from confusables on enteric nervous system development, general smooth muscle relaxation and reproductive smooth muscle.

qualifier: assembly versus disassembly control
name: Regulation of primary cilium assembly and disassembly
rationale: All three members regulate building or resorbing the non-motile cilium, unlike confusables on centrosome positioning, microtubule nucleation and intraflagellar transport.

qualifier: elongation, peroxisomal beta-oxidation and ether lipid synthesis
name: Very long-chain fatty acid elongation, beta-oxidation and ether lipids
rationale: Members span VLCFA elongation and acyl-CoA synthesis, peroxisomal acyl-CoA oxidase beta-oxidation (ALD, pristanoyl-CoA), polyunsaturated LA/ALA metabolism and plasmalogen/wax synthesis, unlike confusables on alpha-oxidation, cholesterol synthesis or peroxisome biogenesis.

qualifier: downstream of oncogenic RAS and RAF1 mutants
name: MEK-ERK activation by oncogenic RAS and RAF1 mutants
rationale: All members describe MAP2K/MAPK activation driven by mutant RAS or RAF1, whereas confusables cover wild-type RAF activation, MRAS/SHOC2, RSK and Rap1/integrin linkages.

qualifier: control of RAC1 and CDC42
name: Axon guidance cues regulating RAC1 and CDC42 activity
rationale: Members are netrin-DCC, SLIT-ROBO and ephrin guidance signalling converging on RAC1/CDC42 activation or inactivation, unlike confusables emphasizing repulsion, L1 signalling and RHOA-dependent midline crossing.

qualifier: receptor activation, trafficking and long-term potentiation
name: NMDA receptor signalling and long-term potentiation
rationale: Members cover NMDA receptor assembly, glutamate activation, Ca2+-triggered Ras/RAC1 signalling and LTP, whereas confusables concern dendritic spine structural plasticity and BDNF-TrkB signalling.

qualifier: priming, polymerase switching and Okazaki flap removal
name: Replication fork priming and lagging-strand DNA synthesis
rationale: All members are steps of replicative DNA synthesis (initiation, primer synthesis, polymerase switching, flap removal, elongation), distinct from confusables on translesion synthesis, repair gap filling and replication licensing.

qualifier: G protein-coupled receptors for ADP, thrombin, thromboxane, prostacyclin
name: G protein-coupled receptor signalling regulating platelet activation
rationale: Members are platelet GPCR pathways (P2Y1, P2Y12, PAR, TP, IP receptors) that activate or restrain platelets, unlike confusables centred on GPVI/collagen, adhesion and degranulation.

qualifier: trabeculation and cardiomyocyte proliferation
name: Ventricular trabeculation and cardiomyocyte proliferation
rationale: All members concern trabecular myocardium formation and ventricular cardiomyocyte growth, distinct from confusables on compact myocardium, second heart field, endocardium and atrial morphogenesis.

qualifier: beta-cell insulin secretion, insulin action, glucagon and glycogen
name: Islet hormone secretion and action in glucose homeostasis
rationale: Members span insulin secretion (KATP channels, incretins, FFAR1), insulin action (IRS, AKT2, GLUT4), glucagon/PKA signalling, glycogen control and glucokinase, distinguishing the theme from confusables on gluconeogenic transcription, ChREBP and adipocyte lipid metabolism.

qualifier: adenosine deamination and phosphorolysis
name: Purine nucleoside catabolism via adenosine deamination and phosphorolysis
rationale: Members cover breakdown of adenosine, inosine, AMP/IMP and deoxypurines via ADA and PNP toward allantoin, unlike confusables on purine salvage, deoxyribonucleotide or pyrimidine catabolism.

qualifier: proteasomal control of GLI, DVL and NOTCH4, nuclear receptor regulation
name: Hedgehog-GLI signalling and proteasomal turnover of developmental regulators
rationale: Members centre on SMO activation and GLI processing/degradation alongside proteasome-dependent turnover of DVL, NOTCH4 and SLIT/ROBO regulation plus retinoic acid/estrogen receptor modulation, unlike confusables on Notch activation, Hh ligand lipidation or planar cell polarity.

qualifier: macrophage and osteoclast development, bone resorption
name: Colony-stimulating factor control of macrophage and osteoclast development
rationale: Members cover M-CSF/GM-CSF signalling and production driving monocyte, macrophage, dendritic cell and osteoclast differentiation and bone remodelling, unlike confusables on macrophage fusion or granulopoiesis.

qualifier: SOS/SHC-driven RAS activation and RSK output
name: SOS-mediated RAS activation and downstream MAPK/RSK signalling
rationale: Members describe positive RAS activation (SOS, SHC/IGF1R, RAS and MAP2K mutants) and outputs to RSK and p38, whereas confusables emphasize RAF/MRAS complexes, RAS GAPs and negative feedback.

qualifier: kinase inhibitor resistance mutants
name: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase mutants and kinase inhibitor resistance
rationale: All members are cancer mutants, fusions or amplifications of KIT, FLT3, PDGFR, ALK, ERBB2/EGFR and FGFRs and their TKI binding or resistance, unlike confusables on normal RTK or cytokine receptor signalling.

qualifier: plant-derived compounds and steroids, sulfonation
name: Xenobiotic, phytochemical and steroid biotransformation
rationale: Members cover cytochrome P450 and sulfonation metabolism of xenobiotics, toxins, plant secondary metabolites (alkaloids, terpenoids, phenylpropanoids, polyketides) and steroids, unlike confusables on acetylation, methylation, CYP2E1 and FMO reactions.

qualifier: ovarian follicle development
name: Gonadotropin secretion regulation and ovarian follicle development
rationale: Members regulate LH/FSH secretion and ovarian follicle development, distinct from confusables on Sertoli/testis, activin signalling and ovulation/luteinization.

qualifier: microglial activation and proliferation
name: Microglial activation and amyloid-beta production and clearance
rationale: Members concern amyloid-beta formation, fibrillization and clearance, APP processing and tangle assembly together with microglial differentiation, activation and cytotoxicity, unlike confusables on apoptotic cell engulfment, DAP12 or oxLDL signalling.
